features.name: Dime AI Chat
features.description: A conversational sports-market analysis and platform-help surface.
provides: Sports-betting explanations and analysis grounded in the current conversation and server-supplied Dime evidence.
Current-thread follow-up context within a bounded recent-message window.
Saved chat threads for the authenticated account.
limitations: Dime cannot place, submit, or settle a wager and cannot move money or change account settings.
Dime must not claim a current line, projection, split, injury, result, or user-specific fact unless that evidence is supplied.
Dime Chat does not currently receive the user's Bet Tracker history or aggregates.

features.name: AI Model Projections
features.description: The Dime feed for owner-published game projections and model outputs.
provides: Published matchup projections and model-derived market values when available for the selected sport and date.
Game-level market and model information presented by the feed.
limitations: Coverage depends on the selected sport, date, published games, available market data, and completed model runs.
A displayed projection is a model estimate, not a guarantee or a placed wager.

features.name: Betting Splits and Odds History
features.description: A sport-and-date view of available betting percentages and opening/current market prices.
provides: Provider-scoped bet and money percentages for supported markets when available.
Opening and current spread, total, moneyline, and price history when available.
limitations: Splits describe the participating provider sample, not the entire betting market.
A difference between bet percentage and money percentage does not prove who caused a line move.
Off-season, unopened, missing, or stale markets can have no usable splits or history.

features.name: Trends
features.description: A desktop Dime shell view of supported trend information; mobile routes to Betting Splits.
provides: Available recent-form and trend views supported by the current product data.
limitations: Trend availability depends on the sport, date, and underlying sample.
A trend is descriptive evidence, not proof of a future outcome or a durable betting edge.

features.name: Bet Tracker
features.description: A private account surface for recording, grading, and reviewing the authorized user's wagers.
provides: Tracked wager entry, results, bankroll and unit views, and performance analytics for the authorized account.
Automatic grading when supported result data is available.
limitations: Bet Tracker access is currently owner-only.
Dime Chat cannot review or coach from Bet Tracker history until a separate authorized user-scoped aggregate connection is implemented.
Dime must not imply that it can see a user's tracked bets merely because the feature exists.

features.name: Prop Projections
features.description: A labeled navigation concept that does not currently have a live product route.
limitations: Dime must not tell a user that a standalone Prop Projections page is currently available.

global_rules: Answer platform questions only from this catalog and the authenticated request context.
Do not infer a user's plan, role, subscription, account state, tracked bets, or permissions when that state was not supplied.
If a requested feature is absent from this catalog, say it is not verified as available and direct the user to the visible product navigation or account support.
Keep platform facts separate from live game evidence, model estimates, and betting recommendations.
